title: Fibre maps factor through strict-local restriction
statement: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes f : X → S, an abelian etale sheaf G on X, a geometric point s : Spec Omega → S, and a geometric point t : Spec Omega-prime → S_(s), let K = G[0]. There exists a canonical morphism a from the derived stalk of Rf_*K at s to derived global sections on X ×_S S_(s) such that the specialization fibre map followed by the strict-base fibre map is a followed by restriction to X_t, and the same comparison followed by restriction to the distinguished closed fibre is the closed strict-base fibre map.

proof.text: Construct the strict-local comparison a from germ restriction, derived exchange and Leray, and identify both fibre composites with its restrictions by representative-neighbourhood germ equations and derived exchange/germ naturality.

theorem strictBaseSheafFiberMap_factorization
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    {Ω' : Type u} [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω']
    (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s) :
    ∃ a : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)) ⟶
      (Sheaf.Γ (pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
          ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
              (pullback.fst f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).obj G)),
      (derivedEtaleStalkSpecialization s t).app
          ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).obj
            ((_root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G)) ≫
          strictBaseSheafFiberMap f G s t =
        a ≫ etaleDerivedRestriction (strictBaseFiberInclusion f s t) _ ∧
      a ≫ etaleDerivedRestriction (strictBaseFiberInclusion f s
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Scheme.strictHenselizationPointEvaluation s)))) _ =
        closedStrictBaseSheafFiberMap f G s
